facts: A dog’s sense of smell is more than 100,000 times stronger than that of a human.
The oldest known breed is likely the Saluki, originally trained by Egyptians to help them track game.
Female dogs carry puppies for about nine weeks before birth.
A dog's sense of smell is so strong that they can detect cancer in humans.
The oldest dog on record was a Australian Cattle Dog named Bluey, who lived to be 29 years and 5 months old.
